zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空同意支付50萬美元和解機師軍事假訴訟
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空同意支付五十萬美元，和解一項涉及163名機師軍事假的訴訟。
body: 根據外國航空媒體 Simple Flying 的報導，阿拉斯加航空（Alaska Airlines）已同意支付五十萬美元（500,000美元）的和解金，以結束一項訴訟。
這起訴訟主要涉及一百六十三名（163名）機師。根據訴訟，航空公司在拒絕超過一百六十名（160名）機師的軍事假（military leave）後遭到起訴，該爭議涉及機師在符合資格的軍事請假期間之特休假累積（vacation accrual）權益。
阿拉斯加航空最終同意支付五十萬美元以達成和解，解決這起因軍事假特休累積爭議而引發的法律訴訟。

en.title: Alaska Airlines Settles Lawsuit For $500,000 Over Pilot Military Leave
en.summary: Alaska Airlines will pay $500,000 to settle a lawsuit involving military leave for 163 pilots.
body: According to a report published by aviation news website Simple Flying, Alaska Airlines has agreed to pay a $500,000 settlement to resolve a legal dispute. This lawsuit was brought against the carrier involving vacation accrual policies for its pilot workforce.

The legal action was initiated after Alaska Airlines refused military leave for over 160 pilots. Specifically, the resolved lawsuit involved vacation accrual for 163 pilots during their qualifying military leave periods.
To settle the lawsuit, Alaska Airlines will pay the total of $500,000. This settlement addresses the dispute over the pilot benefits and vacation accrual during qualifying military leave.

zh.title: 波音777X配備之GE9X引擎預計2027年投入服役
zh.summary: GE9X引擎預計將於2027年隨波音777X客機一同投入服務。
body: 根據外媒《Simple Flying》報導，GE9X引擎預計將於2027年隨波音（Boeing）777X客機一同正式投入服務。該款擁有134英吋風扇的引擎在開發過程中面臨著其他噴射引擎未曾遇過的獨特挑戰。
歷史紀錄顯示，波音777X將獨家配備此款新世代GE9X渦輪扇引擎。此前，GE Aerospace曾因該引擎的中段密封件問題面臨挑戰，但其財務長隨後表示，該問題預計不會延誤波音777X的投入服務計劃。
GE Aerospace指出，重新設計後的中段密封件應能確保波音777X按既定時程在2027年投入服役。目前，波音777X計劃已獲得FAA授權進行認證飛行測試。

en.title: GE9X Engine for Boeing 777X Slated to Launch in 2027
en.summary: The GE9X engine is scheduled to launch on the Boeing 777X in 2027.
body: According to Simple Flying, the GE9X engine is scheduled to launch on the Boeing 777X aircraft in 2027. The engine, featuring a 134-inch fan, faces unique operational and design challenges that are unprecedented for other jet engines.

Verified records show that the Boeing 777X will be exclusively powered by these next-generation GE9X turbofans. GE Aerospace previously addressed mid-seal issues on the engine, with its CFO stating the issues are not expected to delay the 777X's entry into service.

The manufacturer stated that the redesigned GE9X mid-seal should keep the long-delayed aircraft on track for its 2027 debut. The 777X program has already received FAA approval to begin certification flight testing.

zh.title: 美國航空提供超額預訂航班旅客3500美元補償
zh.summary: 美國航空提供超額預訂航班旅客每人三千五百美元補償以放棄機位
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）向一架飛往Nashville（納許維爾）且超額預訂（oversold）的航班旅客提供每人高達3,500美元的補償，以請旅客自願放棄機位。據報導，該航班上載有許多老鷹隊（Eagles）的球迷。
最終有少數旅客接受了美國航空所提供的這項補償方案。此筆價值3,500美元的補償並非以現金支付，而是以美國航空的旅遊代金券（travel vouchers）形式發放給這些自願放棄機位的乘客。

en.title: American Airlines Offered Nashville Passengers $3,500 To Leave Oversold Flight
en.summary: American Airlines offered passengers on an oversold Nashville flight $3,500 each to give up seats.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 20, 2026, American Airlines offered passengers, specifically Eagles fans, a compensation of $3,500 each to get off an oversold flight. The flight was bound for Nashville, and the carrier made this substantial offer in order to resolve the overbooked situation on the aircraft.

Ultimately, a handful of passengers onboard the Nashville flight accepted the offer made by American Airlines. The compensation, which totaled $3,500 per passenger, was paid out to those who volunteered in the form of travel vouchers instead of cash.

zh.title: 胡塞武裝襲擊沙烏地利雅德機場航班受阻 燃料成本上升恐加劇航司壓力
zh.summary: 利雅德與莫斯科因襲擊事件導致航班中斷，加劇航空公司燃油成本壓力。
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）於2026年9月19日遭遇葉門胡塞組織襲擊。襲擊導致該市一處燃料儲藏庫發生火災，現場升起滾滾黑煙波及機場，進而造成該機場的航班運作受到干擾。胡塞武裝宣稱在當天使用飛彈和無人機襲擊了利雅德，而沙烏地當局則表示已攔截相關威脅。
沙烏地阿拉伯官方隨後證實，其防空系統攔截了一枚飛往首都利雅德的彈道飛彈，並挫敗了針對包括紅海石油出口樞紐延布在內其他城市的襲擊。在利雅德當地時間凌晨3時前，居民收到了要求待在室內的警報，並在隨後聽到兩聲爆炸聲。大約半小時後，當局解解除這項警告。此次襲擊再次引發了外界對於航空業能源供應安全的擔憂，尤其目前各家航空公司正承受著顯著上漲的燃料帳單壓力。
與此同時，俄羅斯的石油基礎設施也在同一週末遭到襲擊。烏克蘭於2026年9月20日凌晨發動大規模無人機攻勢，俄羅斯當局報告在全國範圍內攔截了1,110架無人機，其中至少有450架朝莫斯科方向飛去。該次襲擊不僅損壞了莫斯科的主要煉油廠，也導致首都的三個主要機場航班被迫停飛。精煉燃料儲存與出口管道受損，進一步限制了成品的供應。

面對攀升的燃油成本，航空業者已陸續開始採取因應措施。國際航空運輸協會（IATA）的燃油監測數據顯示，在全球煉油廠平均噴射燃料價格達到每桶181.46美元，較前一週上漲6.1%。為應對成本，美國航空在8月和9月期間暫時停飛了部分特定航線。波羅的海航空則於本月申請了美國第11章破產保護，並將原因歸咎於地緣政治不穩定與燃料成本上漲。此外，瑞安航空也將其年度旅客運載目標削減了200萬人次，以降低在冬季面臨高昂燃料成本的風險。

en.title: Houthi and Ukrainian Attacks Disrupt Flights in Riyadh and Moscow as Fuel Costs Rise
en.summary: Riyadh and Moscow airport flights are disrupted following drone and missile attacks as fuel costs rise.
body: According to AeroTime, flights were disrupted at King Khalid International Airport (RUH) in Riyadh on September 19, 2026, following an attack claimed by Yemen's Houthi rebels. A fire at a fuel storage depot sent thick black smoke over the airport, causing flight operational delays. The Houthi rebels claimed they launched missiles and drones toward the Saudi capital, while local authorities confirmed that they intercepted several incoming threats.

Saudi officials reported that the country intercepted a ballistic missile targeting Riyadh and successfully thwarted separate attacks aimed at other cities, including the Red Sea oil-export hub of Yanbu. Shortly before 03:00 local time, residents in Riyadh received alerts advising them to stay indoors, hearing two explosions before the warning was lifted about thirty minutes later. The security situation has renewed concerns over global energy supply security as airlines face rising operational fuel costs.

In a separate development over the same weekend, Russia's energy infrastructure was targeted in a massive drone assault launched by Ukraine overnight into September 20, 2026. Russian authorities claimed they intercepted 1,110 drones nationwide, with at least 450 directed towards Moscow. The drone strikes damaged Moscow's main oil refinery and grounded commercial flights at the capital's three primary airports. Disruptions to such facilities threaten the supply of refined jet fuel, exacerbating price pressures on commercial carriers.

The International Air Transport Association (IATA) fuel monitor reported that the average global refinery price of jet fuel rose to $181.46 per barrel, representing a 6.1% increase from the prior week. In response to these soaring costs, several carriers have adjusted schedules. American Airlines temporarily suspended selected routes during August and September. Additionally, airBaltic filed for U.S. Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection this month, citing geopolitical instability and fuel prices, while Ryanair reduced its annual passenger target by two million to limit exposure to expensive winter fuel.
